approach: Manual and AI-aided reverse engineering of the DOS executable into portable C, with rebuildable original assembly, SDL3 ports and native Amiga and HolyC backends.
notes: Continuation of Restunts with replay-compatible physics, HyperVision rendering, upscaled artwork. Additional ports which couldn't fit the 8 element limited list: TempleOS, OpenBSD, NetBSD, Amiga. All builds require user-supplied Brøderbund Stunts 1.1 game data (12 February 1991). Physics and rendered replay frames are checked against original game code in CI.
